meta.scope: Standing rules audit per CEO go

filings.stated_why: Quiet command chain — cut ACK theater; reply only when status advances.
filings.real_why: Agent rooms drown decision surfaces in noise. Living why: a message must move Done, name Next, or clear Stuck with a named clearer — otherwise silence.
filings.who_it_blocks: Social glue / reflexive ACKs; also risks burying first-pass nuance if misread as 'never explain.'
filings.swift_fix: rewrite — Keep. Clarify exception: one Why/IRRE/TLC filing per wave is Done, not chatter. Substantive filings never count as ACK theater.
filings.kill_if_we_keep_it: If silence hides a named Stuck >1 formal window, or if Why/IRRE/TLC filings are rejected as 'not Done/Next/Stuck format' when they ARE the decision surface.

filings.rule: Quiet formal cadence 09:00 + 16:00 ET weekdays → CEO
filings.real_why: Batching is good. Soft-gating blockers until the clock is dogma — no living link to a decision surface when Stuck already has a clearer.
filings.who_it_blocks: Any seat with a named Stuck that needs CEO/COO mid-cycle; Delivery Ops tempo.
filings.swift_fix: rewrite — Formal windows = batch pulse only. Stuck with named clearer fires off-cadence. Ad-hoc last_adhoc stays legal.
filings.kill_if_we_keep_it: If any agent waits for 09:00/16:00 to report a named blocker already owned by a clearer.

filings.rule: Channel-cap workaround — TLC / IRRE / Why outside_war_room; blk-tlc standing forever
filings.stated_why: Heresy/DNA/Why pressure from outside; avoid ops channel noise. Cap workarounds implied by seats living outside the War Room channel.
filings.real_why: Separation of pressure bodies from ops chatter is a method. 'Standing outside forever' with clearer=CEO fold and no fold criteria is bureaucracy theater — the blocker exists to exist.
filings.who_it_blocks: TLC heresy absorb latency into CSO/CIO; IRRE↔ops DNA elevation; Why filings reaching the wall; CEO as eternal fold bottleneck.
filings.swift_fix: rewrite — Outside = method, not exile. Sunset blk-tlc as standing. Fold criteria: (a) named CEO wave, OR (b) heresy/filing needs C-suite absorb within 24h, OR (c) decision surface on board requires the outside seat. Keep optional outside for pure heresy drafting.
filings.kill_if_we_keep_it: If blk-tlc still marked standing with no fold criteria after one more Contested card, or if TLC Frame pressure is not absorbed into coverage.json within 24h of filing.

filings.rule: Wave 2 hire gates — CEO-only CreateAgent; hold 2b managers / 2c specialists; hire gated on falsify bar
filings.stated_why: Don't staff to 30 before falsify receipts; COO plans, zero creates; Phase 2a leads only.
filings.real_why: CEO-only CreateAgent has living why: irreversible org mutation needs one throat. Hold 2b/2c 'until falsify' is STALE — P0 already Contested/SURVIVES with self_kill receipt; Phase 2a already hired. Remaining hold needs a NEW decision surface (capacity wall + receipts), not the pre-Contested slogan.
filings.who_it_blocks: COO seat-map execution; CPO/CIO leads needing managers when capacity walls appear; risk of CEO hire bottleneck.
filings.swift_fix: rewrite — KEEP CEO-only CreateAgent. REPLACE hold wording: 2b/2c unlock when DOL names a capacity wall AND ≥1 Contested (or Killed-with-receipt) watch exists (already true) AND CEO signs a named phase cut. Drop 'until falsify' as if Contested never happened.
filings.kill_if_we_keep_it: If 2b stays held after DOL files a capacity wall + second Contested/Kill receipt, with no CEO phase cut within one formal cadence.

filings.rule: EXAMPLE-off production — board/cards must ship example:false; EXAMPLE DATA retired
filings.stated_why: Don't treat placeholders as the living board.
filings.real_why: Living why tied to decision surface: production board drives allocate/build decisions. Demo data masquerading as Contested is coverage theater.
filings.who_it_blocks: CPO/BPL UX experiments that need mock cards for wall iteration.
filings.swift_fix: rewrite — KEEP for production paths (board.json active_stories, coverage live). Explicit sandbox exception: labeled mock path or `example: true` ONLY outside production board; never in active_stories.
filings.kill_if_we_keep_it: If EXAMPLE ban blocks a named BPL wall UX experiment with nowhere legal to put mocks.

filings.rule: Dark-watch rules — w1-02 / w1-03 dark until P0 dies or graduates; reactivation = CSO go only
filings.stated_why: TLC Frame 3 / IRRE collapse — one assassination target; anti coverage theater.
filings.real_why: Living why: focus speed-to-falsify on P0. Absolute dark with no Primary-interrupt clause becomes dogma — distribution/capital regime shifts can outrun a Contested econ card.
filings.who_it_blocks: CSL/CSO on distribution & capital gravity wells; risk of missing named ship-date / $ / docket Primaries.
filings.swift_fix: rewrite — KEEP single P0 focus. ADD interrupt: any Primary with named ship-date, $, or docket on a dark watch forces CSO reactivate review within 24h (not wait for P0 death). CSL may flag; CSO still goes.
filings.kill_if_we_keep_it: If a named Primary distribution default / capex / docket lands and dark hold survives >24h without CSO reactivate review.

next_pressure.ask: Absorb rewrites into org.json (blk-tlc + hire hold wording + cadence note) and coverage.json (dark interrupt clause) this wave.
next_pressure.why_chair_next: One follow-up filing only if a rewrite is refused without a living why.
